summary: Offizielle Release-Notes (v0.35.0): ## Decision models Ollama now supports decision models through `/v1/systemone`, based on [TypeSafe’s Jev API](https://typesafe.ai). Decision models return choices, probabilities, and scores instead of text. Use them for tasks such as ticket triage, model routing, and content classification.
